package: zip holding docpipe.py only; standard library; no layers

work_units_source.run: livetest_20261122-090236 (us-east-2, 1024 MB, 22 Nov 2026 09:02 CST; saved manifest 'calibration')
work_units_source.method: campaign.calibrate: linear fit of handler time on K at 1024 MB, reference document of the mean size

reference_matched_by_construction: K was fitted so that each stage's warm handler time at 1024 MB equals the paper's mean (0.8/4.0/2.5/1.2 s) on the reference document; 1024 MB warm times therefore reproduce the targets by construction and are a check, not a finding. The same K is used at 512, 2048 and 3008 MB, so the measured trend is Lambda's own scaling of this fixed work.

input_mix.description: one reference document for every invocation of a stage, at every size: doc_seed 20261121, 3,000 words (the calibration document). The P2 log-normal size mix is NOT used: its spread is by construction and would swamp the cold-minus-warm difference.

module_scope_inside_INIT: standard-library imports: base64, hashlib, json, os, re, tempfile, time, unicodedata, uuid, zlib
_build_tables(PRISM_INIT_ROWS = 0): empty, so no classifier/lexicon start-up work (decision P3 default)
one 'env_init' JSON log line; four regular expressions compiled
startup_behaviour.first_invocation: no extra work: the handler only flags cold=True; any first-use costs (Unicode tables, regex and zlib first use) fall inside Duration and are measured as X
startup_behaviour.not_present: no network, no files, no dependency outside the standard library; sink 'none' (boto3 never imported); PRISM_CALIBRATION=0 (k_override ignored)
startup_behaviour.consequence: the cold penalty measured is the platform's plus the standard library's; the paper's 6 s mean initialisation has no code counterpart here (P3), so magnitudes are not the paper's

invocation: synchronous Invoke (RequestResponse, LogType=Tail) of each stage function directly from the client; no Step Functions in this campaign
